newsitem.title: LEBANON: Malaysian PM says Lebanon "good" for investment.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian PM says Lebanon "good" for investment.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said on Wednesday Lebanon had a good investment environment and should be able to attract foreign investors.
"I think Lebanon is now a good place for investment... In the extent that we can foresee, Lebanon is a good risk," Mahathir told a news conference at the end of a three-day official trip to Lebanon.
He said incentives for foreign investment were "well in place" and that Lebanon's economic sectors including industry should be able to attract foreign investment.

"I think businessmen must of course take into consideration the so-called country risk published by certain agencies. As far as I can see... although there are risks in many areas, I think Lebanon would be described as a good risk," he added.
